# RN-3 (KOBE-747): packages, binaries, file paths, identifiers, log fields (spec §4 step 3).
# Hand work: regenerate pnpm-lock.yaml (pnpm install), THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md and NOTICE
# (pnpm licenses:update), tools/license-check/inventory.yaml; tsconfig/eslint path names.
#
# Same format as allowlist.txt (scripts/rename/README.md). The script changes an occurrence only
# where a pattern below matches it AND the allowlist gives it to this step AND no permanent entry
# covers it. Generated files and the allowlist's "Triage:" groups are left out on purpose: the
# dry run lists them as left for hand edits until this step's ticket narrows them into patterns.

== RN-3: Paired values: fake-model markers and test values the e2e harness and the code or its tests share (renamed together)
** /\bkobe-(?:e2e|faux|learn|long-answer|slow-start|tool-step)\b/
** /\bkobe\.e2e\.member\b/
** /\bdata-kobe[\w-]*/
** /\bfetch_kobe\b/
** /\bcm-kobe-[\w-]+/
** /\bkobe\.acme\.test\b/
** /\bkobe\d+[\w-]*/
** /[\w.+-]*kobe[\w.+-]*@[\w-]+(?:\.[\w-]+)+/i
** /\bkobe_live_value\b/

== RN-3: Workspace packages and their imports; binaries (`kobe` operator CLI, `kobe-migrate`, `kobe-db-wait`)
** /@kobe\/[\w./-]*/
** /\bkobe-(?:migrate|db-wait)\b/
** /\bkobe (?=backup|restore|projects|sso|command-line|CLI)/
packages/cli/package.json /"kobe": "/

** /\bKOBE_(?:WRITES_PER_HOUR_KEY|WRITES_PER_HOUR_DEFAULT|TOOLS_TIMEOUT_MS|TOOL|TEAM_SAMPLES|SKILL_NAMES_ADDED_LATER|SKILL_NAMES|SKILL_IDS|SITE_TOOLS|SITE_SAMPLES|SEED_RETRY|SECTIONS|RESULT_MAX_BYTES|READS_PER_MINUTE_KEY|READS_PER_MINUTE_DEFAULT|PROVIDER_ID|PROVIDER|PAGE_MAX|PACKAGES_DIR|MODEL_ERROR_PREFIX|MEMORY_ITEM_TOOLS|MCP_TEAM_SETTING|MCP_TEAM_LEVELS|MCP_TEAM_LEVEL_DEFAULT|MCP_MODES|MCP_MODE_LABELS|MCP_MODE_KEY|MCP_MODE_DEFAULT|MCP_HINTS|LIMITS|LIMIT_MIN|LIMIT_MAX|LEVEL_LABELS|GALLERY_KEY|FILE|EVENT_TYPES|EVENT_DROPPED_TYPE|ENDPOINTS|DOCS_TOOLS|DIR|BUILTIN_NAMES|BUILTIN_CONNECTOR_URL|BUILTIN_CONNECTOR_ID|AGENT_KEY|ADMIN_WRITE_REASON|ADMIN_TOOLS|ADMIN_TEXT|ADMIN_SUMMARY_MAX|ADMIN_RESULT_HIDDEN|ADMIN_NOT_REMEMBERED|ADMIN_NOT_ALLOWED_REASON)\b/
